name: I Don't Know What This Podcast is Called

episodes.title: Rap Battles, Cult Survivors, & Comedy Camp Chaos with the Princes of Persia
episodes.description:
🎙️ From rap battles to construction sites to cult survivors, this one has it all.  
In Episode 2 of "I Don't Know What This Podcast Is Called," host Levi J Anderson sits down with two of the Pacific Northwest's most dynamic comedians: DJ Kamoflage and Jake Woodmansee. Individually they're killer comics. Together, they tour as The Princes of Persia, a live comedy show that blends stand-up, improv games, and even live freestyle rapping.  
But this conversation is anything but a typical comedy interview.  
The trio kicks things off with a debate about the shortest month on the calendar (Black History Month, anyone?) before diving into the origin story of The Princes of Persia, which began with a kitchen freestyle session over some legendary chicken wings and evolved into an interactive live show featuring flag-waving pranks, HOA revenge fantasies, and live bands that keep everyone guessing.  
From there, things get real. Jake opens up about his unique approach to producing shows, benefit events that cut out the middleman and put money directly into the hands of people in need. He also shares stories about growing up in a cult, why kids should be focused on boogers and poop instead of politics, and the time he introduced a 22-year-old her first full Clif Bar.

🎤 Episode Highlights:
• How a casual freestyle session over chicken wings birthed an entire live show
• Why construction sites are more fun with Lizzo and polka music
• And a heartfelt reflection on being "the first one out" of a cult
The Princes of Persia are a must-see live comedy experience—and this episode gives you a front-row seat to the friendship, chaos, and creativity behind the curtain.
